# Massoda

> Jean Emilien Massoda builds business software, product prototypes, integrations and operational tools across Go, Python, PHP/WordPress, React and TypeScript. Available for remote engineering roles, freelance and contract work.

The engineering portfolio includes backend services, WordPress and WooCommerce plugins, operations consoles, APIs, integrations and frontend systems. The Business Systems Lab presents five product experiments and free guided pilots. Each case study distinguishes a browser demo from a locally run service or plugin. A separate creative practice covers illustration, logo animation and motion design.

## Work with me

- [Business software and engineering offers](https://massoda.me/work-with-me.html): Operational workflows, WordPress and WooCommerce plugins, APIs, integrations, guided prototypes and remote engineering roles.

## Services

- [UI/UX Design](https://massoda.me/services/web-design.html): User-centred design, wireframes, prototypes, and design systems.
- [Interaction & Motion Design](https://massoda.me/services/interaction-design.html): Micro-interactions, scroll-driven animation, transition systems.
- [Frontend Engineering](https://massoda.me/services/web-development.html): Production frontend development, Core Web Vitals, accessibility, component architecture.
- [Mobile Application Development](https://massoda.me/services/mobile-application.html): Cross-platform mobile engineering with React Native and Flutter.
- [Web Application Development](https://massoda.me/services/web-application.html): Scalable SaaS and enterprise web application frontend engineering.
- [Machine Learning Engineering](https://massoda.me/services/machine-learning.html): ML system design and deployment.
- [Data Analytics & Intelligence](https://massoda.me/services/data-analytics.html): Dashboards, ETL pipelines, KPI frameworks.

## Featured Case Studies

- [Mobi-Kumbu](https://massoda.me/portfolio/mobikumbu.html): Full-stack mobile money and USSD wallet platform — mobile app, web dashboard, backend, and AWS infrastructure, serving five countries.
- [FreshBox Tech Marketplace](https://massoda.me/portfolio/freshbox-tech-marketplace.html): Multi-vendor B2B marketplace built on WooCommerce and WCFM with a custom mega-menu system.
- [Residences Loumia](https://massoda.me/portfolio/residences-loumia.html): UI/UX design and GSAP interaction work for a multi-property luxury hospitality platform.
- [Bpétale](https://massoda.me/portfolio/bpetale-ltd.html): Multi-brand WordPress/Elementor design system spanning Natural Essence skincare, Travels & Tours, and Krunchies.
- [Eth AI Forecaster](https://massoda.me/portfolio/eth-ai-forecaster.html): Python/Jupyter machine learning project forecasting Ethereum price movement from historical data.
- [Phenotyping Flow](https://massoda.me/portfolio/phenotyping-flow.html): Interaction design for a hospital/lab hardware control interface, designed in Figma.
- [Fashionista Africa](https://massoda.me/portfolio/fashionista-africa.html): WordPress build for an African fashion brand.
- [Leads Tracker](https://massoda.me/portfolio/leads-tracker.html): Chrome Extension for saving URLs to revisit later.
- [Agribusiness](https://massoda.me/portfolio/agribusiness.html): In-progress frontend for an affiliate agri-business marketplace.
- [Sneaker Shop](https://massoda.me/portfolio/sneaker-shop.html): Responsive single-page landing design concept.

## Recent engineering prototypes

- [EventFlow Go](https://massoda.me/portfolio/eventflow-go.html): When an order changes, the next system needs the update even if it is temporarily unavailable.
- [IntakeDesk](https://massoda.me/portfolio/intakedesk.html): Make it easier to see where every new enquiry stands before work begins.
- [VendorPulse](https://massoda.me/portfolio/vendorpulse.html): Give slow and stuck orders a clear human follow-up instead of another forgotten dashboard number.
- [PacketLens](https://massoda.me/portfolio/packetlens.html): See which required documents arrived, which still need review, and why a packet is not ready.
- [SignalDesk](https://massoda.me/portfolio/signaldesk.html): Put exceptions from separate workflows into one place with an owner and a next action.
- [BridgeGate](https://massoda.me/portfolio/bridgegate.html): Make a failed system handoff visible and recoverable.
